name: Hiroki Maeda
bio: Hiroki Maeda (前田 弘喜, Maeda Hiroki; born August 4, 1983) is a Japanese voice actor from Kochi Prefecture who is affiliated with Air Agency. He speaks the Tosa dialect. He is 1.64 m tall and has blood type A. His hobbies include karaoke, manga, and massage. His special skill is sword fighting.
